title: Add an option to quickly disable the Colour blindness Correct Effect to the Brightness and Colour widget
line: The Brightness and Color widget now has a switch to quickly turn color blindness correction off and on again.
explanation: Color blindness correction is a KWin effect that can only be turned on or off in System Settings > Accessibility, so people who need it off for a moment (watching a video, sharing the screen with someone) had to dig through settings twice, or bind a D-Bus toggleEffect call to a shortcut. The Brightness and Color applet had no control for it. The applet now shows a "Color Blindness Correction" item with a "Correct colors" switch and a Configure… button, only when the effect is enabled in settings (or currently loaded); the switch calls KWin's loadEffect/unloadEffect over D-Bus, so the saved setting is untouched and correction comes back at next login.

commits.message:
applets/brightness: add a color blindness correction toggle

When color blindness correction is enabled, turning it off for a while
meant going deep into System Settings. The applet now shows a switch for
it that loads or unloads KWin's effect for the current session only.

BUG: 484196

media.caption: Correction enabled and active, but the Brightness and Color popup has no way to turn it off
The popup now has a Color Blindness Correction item with a Correct colors switch
After flipping the switch off: KWin unloads the effect and the original colors come back
With correction disabled in System Settings the item stays hidden
